item.title: Watch Live: Lindsay Clancy trial resumes with forensic psychologist testimony
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial resumed Tuesday in Massachusetts with more testimony from a forensic psychologist hired by the prosecution.

item.title: Russian ex-official says "unknown sources" could attack U.K. drone plants
item.description: Former senior Russian diplomat says U.K. factories making drones for Ukraine "could be attacked - not by Russia, but from unknown sources."

item.title: At least 1 in 4 ex-NFL players who died from 2016 to 2021 had CTE, study finds
item.description: The rate is much higher than is seen in the general population. CTE is a brain disease linked to repeated blows to the head.

item.title: South Carolina holds runoff to replace late Sen. Lindsey Graham on ballot
item.description: Darline Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, is facing off against Rep. Ralph Norman for the GOP nomination.

item.title: U.S. airman faces charges for criticizing Trump over Iran war
item.description: The charges against Major Jason Watson are believed to be the first time in U.S. military history that a major has been charged under Article 88.

item.title: CIA Director John Ratcliffe on secret trip in Russia
item.description: A U.S. Air Force Boeing C-17A Globemaster III transport plane was spotted at a Moscow airport, along with a U.S. diplomatic motorcade, according to public reports.

item.title: Pennsylvania records first 2 measles deaths in 35 years
item.description: Pennsylvania has recorded its first two deaths connected to measles in 35 years.

item.title: Iran says it's ready for new U.S. sanctions, has 2-year plan
item.description: Iran's economy minister said the country has been preparing for a long time for the sanctions U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent described as the "greatest financial offensive" ever.

item.title: Trump gets his way on mail-in voting for now
item.description: The Supreme Court will allow portions of President Trump's executive order restricting mail-in voting to proceed for now. CBS News' legal reporter Katrina Kaufman has more information.

item.title: United Airlines to add 10 new international routes. See where.
item.description: The new overseas routes represent the largest expansion in the airline's history, United said.

item.title: Musk's data centers push out family that's owned land for generations
item.description: A plant in Southaven, Mississippi, that powers Elon Musk's SpaceXAI data centers in the area has sparked backlash from residents concerned about noise and air pollution.

item.title: Elon Musk's data center cluster sparks backlash from residents
item.description: In Southaven, Mississippi, some residents are pushing back on SpaceXAI's expanding footprint in the region.

item.title: How much will a $100,000 home equity loan cost per month if opened this September?
item.description: Home equity loan borrowing costs have changed. Here's how much a $100,000 home equity loan will cost monthly now.

item.title: Exclusive discounts from CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: On this edition of CBS Deals, we show you items that will help improve your everyday lifestyle. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: Will Darline Graham's national security flub turn off voters?
item.description: Darline Graham is facing off against Ralph Norman in today's Republican Senate runoff in a South Carolina special election. Meanwhile, Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed distanced himself from progressive influencer Hasan Piker over his comments on Israel and Jewish Americans. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Judge rejects Ghislaine Maxwell's effort to overturn sex-trafficking conviction
item.description: A federal judge on Tuesday rejected Ghislaine Maxwell's effort to toss out her 2021 conviction on sex-trafficking charges and 20-year prison sentence.

item.title: Highlights from China's World Humanoid Games, and what it means for the future
item.description: China's World Humanoid Robot Games is a technological showcase, but also a possible glimpse into the future of robotics. Anna Coren reports.

item.title: Michigan's El-Sayed distances himself from Hasan Piker
item.description: Michigan Senate Democratic hopeful Abdul El-Sayed is working to distance himself from progressive influencer Hasan Piker over his rhetoric about American Jews. Ed O'Keefe has the latest.

item.title: Callaway Golf CEO says "mistakes were made" over controversial ad
item.description: The ad for a new driver had sparked an online backlash, with viewers criticizing the spot for trivializing violence against women.

item.title: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York could be punished by NFL for prostitution arrest
item.description: San Francisco 49ers owner and CEO Jed York was arrested in Ohio over the weekend and pleaded no contest to amended charges originally stemming from a prostitution arrest. Now, he could face punishment from the NFL. Carter Evans reports.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial moves toward closing arguments, with final witness expected soon
item.description: The prosecution's final rebuttal witness is expected Tuesday in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother who admitted to killing her children in a state of postpartum psychosis. Closing arguments are expected Wednesday.

item.title: Trump administration warns nations to isolate Iran amid aggressive economic strategy
item.description: The Trump administration is levying new sanctions against Iran as a form of economic warfare. Meanwhile, Canada announced plans to impose retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. after a trade deal fell through. CBS News' Weijia Jiang and Ramy Inocencio have the latest.

item.title: Trump threatens to change Lake Ontario's name as trade war with Canada heats up
item.description: President Trump said the U.S. is considering changing the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America" amid an escalating trade fight with Canada.

item.title: Gary Mayor Eddie Melton reacts as parts of Indiana remain in the dark after storm
item.description: Thousands of residents in Gary, Indiana, are waiting for their lights to come back on, two weeks after powerful storms slammed into their city. Mayor Eddie Melton speaks out on the city's efforts to restore power and improve conditions.

item.title: United Airlines announces largest international expansion in company's history
item.description: United Airlines is expanding to 10 new international destinations, including Okinawa, Japan, and Ibiza, Spain. Scott Kirby, the airline's CEO, joins "CBS Mornings" with more.

item.title: Air Force officer who criticized Trump faces rare criminal charges
item.description: U.S. Air Force Maj. Jason Watson is facing criminal charges after he criticized President Trump in public. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata has more information.

item.title: Thousands flee the Hawk Fire in Reno
item.description: The Hawk Fire has exploded in size, forcing thousands to evacuate from Reno, Nevada. CBS News' Jason Allen reports.

item.title: Questions arise after Trump administration announces Iran sanctions
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's announcement Monday on Iran sanctions has raised questions over how they might be implemented. Meanwhile, Canada is set to announce retaliatory tariffs against the U.S. Weijia Jiang has the latest.

item.title: Canada's leaders blast Trump as a bully as trade war intensifies
item.description: Canada plans to impose retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. Meanwhile, Vice President JD Vance said Canada is "taking advantage" of America. CBS News' Bradley Blackburn reports.

item.title: Amazon driver strikes 71-year-old man in Northern California gas station in newly released video
item.description: Newly released surveillance video shows an Amazon delivery driver striking a 71-year-old man inside an Elk Grove gas station earlier this year after a dispute over a parking space, officials said.
